intro: In Duskwood, the Tear of Tilloa grows on the Mistmantle estate near Darkshire. Its alchemical use draws interest from those seeking rare reagents.

p: The Tear of Tilloa grows on the grounds of Stalvan Mistmantle’s estate outside Darkshire. Duskwood’s soil has turned hostile to wholesome vegetation, yet the small white flower persists among the shadowed plots. It grows rarely and in a secluded place, drawing those who seek uncommon reagents beyond lawful markets.
